The '''2021–22 Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball team''' represented [[Mississippi State University]] during the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by seventh-year head coach [[Ben Howland]], and played their home games at [[Humphrey Coliseum]] in [[Starkville, Mississippi]] as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. They finished the season 18–16, 8–10 in [[2021–22 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish 10th place. They defeated [[2021–22 South Carolina Gamecocks men's basketball team|South Carolina]] in the second round of the [[2022 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] before losing to [[2021–22 Tennessee Volunteers basketball team|Tennessee]] in the quarterfinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2022 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they lost in the first round to [[2021–22 Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball team|Virginia]].

Following the season, the school fired head coach Howland.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-03-17 |title=Howland out at Mississippi State after 7 seasons |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/33527294/ben-howland-men-basketball-coach-mississippi-state |access-date=2022-03-21 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}}</ref> On March 20, 2022, the school named [[New Mexico State Aggies men's basketball|New Mexico State]] head coach [[Chris Jans]] the team's new head coach.

==Previous season==
In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2020–21 Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball team|Bulldogs]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 18–15, 8–10 in [[2020–21 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish in ninth place. They defeated [[2020–21 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Kentucky]] in the second round of the [[2021 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] before losing to [[2020–21 Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball team|Alabama]] in the quarterfinals. They received an invitation to the [[2021 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] as the fourth seed in the Saint Louis bracket. There they defeated [[2020–21 Saint Louis Billikens men's basketball team|Saint Louis]],<ref>{{Cite web|title=Mississippi State vs. Saint Louis - Game Recap - March 20, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401311780|access-date=2021-09-29|website=ESPN.com|language=en}}</ref> [[2020–21 Richmond Spiders men's basketball team|Richmond]],<ref>{{Cite web|title=Mississippi State vs. Richmond - Game Recap - March 25, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401311781|access-date=2021-09-29|website=ESPN.com|language=en}}</ref> and [[2020–21 Louisiana Tech Bulldogs basketball team|Louisiana Tech]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=Louisiana Tech vs. Mississippi State - Game Summary - March 27, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/game/_/gameId/401311786|access-date=2021-09-29|website=ESPN.com|language=en}}</ref> to advance the championship game where they lost to [[2020–21 Memphis Tigers men's basketball team|Memphis]].
